content: Arduino IDE 2.0 is a well-documented Theia adopter (Eclipse Foundation adopter story): built on Theia for Monaco editor + LSP + extensibility while keeping UI approachable for beginners; needed custom toolbar/simplified UX layered over the full IDE shell via Theia's extension points rather than stripping core packages. Gitpod also runs Theia-derived tooling for cloud dev environments (historical; Gitpod later moved toward VS Code-in-browser for some products) -- both are cited as the standard 'known-good adopter' reference cases, not deep postmortems.
